description_zh: 皮卡在绿灯路口直行时，因前方乘用车减速而追尾，测试皮卡能否及时制动避免碰撞。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was stopped in the rightmost non-HOV lane on northbound 3rd Street waiting for the intersection at Stevenson Street to clear during a green light.
The passenger car behind the Waymo AV was rear-ended by a pickup truck, causing the front of the passenger car to make contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
TYPE OF COLLISION: C. REAR END (X)
evidence.reason: 选取移动的皮卡作为 ego（测试其追尾前车的制动决策），乘用车作为前方减速车辆（front_brake），忽略静止的 Waymo AV 以聚焦关键双方冲突。控制信号为绿灯，环境晴朗下午。
